content.what_it_is: MATLAB spectrum inspection script that loads frequency, direction, and HMO component grids (L2-L7), converts squared component heights to energy, cell-averages adjacent bins, derives 2-D density and frequency/direction marginals (L9-L46), then plots marginal curves, a filled density contour, and a recomputed Hrms value (L49-L87).
entities: script workspace cleared by clear all @L1

equations.ref: initial energy from all squared spectrum entries
direction increments converted from degrees to radians
cell energy divided by angular and frequency widths
displayed Hrms recomputed from cell energy

unresolved: The raw pcolor drawn at L7 is later erased when figure(1) is selected and clf is called at L53-L54; no pause or save occurs between them, so the initial visualization has no lasting output (L7, L53-L54).

No nonzero or monotonic-spacing check precedes divisions by dangle and dfre at L22, L35, and L42; duplicate coordinate entries produce division by zero, and descending entries produce signed negative densities (L14-L15, L22, L35, L42).

If either loaded coordinate has fewer than two entries, the loops at L18-L26 and/or L31-L43 do not define Em, Dens, F, A, D_f, or D_a before those names are used at L46 and L56-L73; the file has no size guard (L16-L46, L56-L73).

The initial Etotal/Hrms path at L9-L10 is never consumed before Hrms is overwritten from Etotal_1 at L83 and only then displayed at L86; the first Hrms calculation is dead relative to observable output (L9-L10, L83, L86).

v is defined at L71, but both consumers that use v are commented out at L72 and L74 while contourf at L73 uses the literal level count 40, leaving v disconnected from the active contour path (L71-L74).
